what.text: This page follows refugees from Senegal living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4494 Senegalese refugees in France, 34.5% of all refugees from Senegal.
France is the largest host of Senegalese refugees, followed by Gambia, Canada and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Casamance territory in Senegal in periods from 1990 to 2011, with the MFDC.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2021 to 2025, come after the last of those conflict years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 35 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
